I searched the memory index for `wouldExceedLimit` (defined in `src/config/plan-limits.ts` as "True when consuming `requested` more units would breach the quota") and verified each candidate by reading the full file to confirm it actually invokes the function directly, rather than just going through `getPlanLimits`/`getLimit` and comparing manually.

Files that call `getPlanLimits` and do their own comparison (e.g. `create-issue.ts`, `create-project.ts`, `create-webhook.ts`, `invite-member.ts`, `accept-invitation.ts`, `use-plan-limits.ts`) do not count — they only read the plan's numbers through the neighboring helper.

Direct callers of `wouldExceedLimit`:
- `src/actions/billing/change-plan.ts` — checks the target plan still fits current usage on downgrade
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` — `checkLimit()` and `changePlan()` both call it
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` — `createWebhook()` gate
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts` — `inviteMembers()` seat-quota gate
- `src/server/services/project-service.ts` — `createProject()` gate
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` — `createIssue()` gate

ANSWER: src/actions/billing/change-plan.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts
